name: Hank Brown
summary: George Hanks "Hank" Brown (born February 12, 1940) is an American politician and lawyer from Colorado. A member of the Republican Party, he served as a U.S. Representative and U.S. Senator. He served as the president of the University of Northern Colorado from July 1998 to June 2002, and later as the 21st president of the University of Colorado system from April 2005 to January 2008.
